1. Source accounting duplicated the old ASCII POM declaration guard and accepted UTF-16 entity declarations. It now reuses #55's encoding-aware guard and retains declaration formatting; two meaningful encoding regressions added.
2. A post-Maven source-hash exception could leave the compatibility receipt successful. The exception now forces failure; its regression preserves Maven exit zero and the actual error while asserting a failed receipt.

Both failing runs are preserved. No additional material finding remains in the scoped engineering reviews. Current handoff/STATUS and Project observations are reconciled. - Broad XML, MapFish, referencing, GeoFence, importer/GDAL, recovered-source, logging, database and Jupyter native suites were **not rerun**. Historical failures/skips remain explicit.
- Whole-diff whitespace diagnostics are confined to six retained CRLF JavaCSV logs and one original failing unittest line; these raw bytes are preserved, with source/docs checks clean when excluding those exact outputs.
